صَيْدَلَانِىٌّ (S, M, Mgh, Msb, K) a word of wellknown meaning: (M:) A seller of medicines (Mgh, Msb, TA) and of drugs (TA) and of perfumes: (K, TA:) a rel. n. from صَيْدَلَانُ, the name of a town or place, (K,) or from صَيْدَلٌ meaning as expl. above; (IB, TA;) or a Pers. word arabicized: (M:) and صَيْدَنَانِىٌّ signifies the same, (S, Msb, K, [in the CK, erroneously, صَنْدَنَانِىٌّ,]) and so صَنْدَلَانِىٌّ: (K in this art., and O and K in art. صندل:) the pl. of the first is صَيَادِلَةٌ. (M, Mgh, Msb, K.) ―
-b2- Also A king: and so صَيْدَنَانِىٌّ. (M in art. صدن.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
